sentence_stem: If you book before the end of the month,
correct_completion: you will get a discount on your trip.
full_sentence: If you book before the end of the month, you will get a discount on your trip.
acceptable_variants: you will pay less for your trip.
you can save money on your trip.

options.text: you got a discount last year.
options.why_wrong: The stem is a condition about the future, so the completion must describe a possible future result, not a past event.

options.text: the hotel is near the beach.
options.why_wrong: This describes the hotel but does not complete the result that the 'if' clause introduces.

options.text: you will get a discount on your trip.
the tickets are sold out now.
options.why_wrong: This is a present fact about the tickets, not the result that depends on booking early.

explanation: The connector 'if' introduces a condition, so the completion must give the result that depends on that condition. In the first conditional, this result is usually a future action with 'will'.
translation: Se você reservar antes do fim do mês, você terá desconto na sua viagem.
